simple.meaning: הִין (hîyn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a hin or liquid measure.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 22 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Ezekiel, beginning at Exodus 29:40. Its contexts include offering, sacrifice, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הִין (H1969).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1969. hin הִין noun masculine Lev 19:36 hin , a liquid measure ( ᵐ5 εἴν ( Ἴν ; ᵐ5 L Ἴν ); but χοῦς 19:36 ; Greek ἴυιον , Egyptian measure, = sextarius , accusative to Böckh Metrol. Unters. 244 compare Brandis Münz- Mass- & Gewichtswesen 29, 30 ; the Hebrew hin (6.06 litres) was, however, much larger than the Egyptian hin (0.456 litre), see Hultsch Metrol., Tab. xxi. p. 714, & pp. 368, 450 ff. ; see further Ri HWB Smith Dict.Bib. EMey Geschichte. i. 228 ) — absolute הִין Exod 30:24 4 t. Ezekiel 45:46; הַהִין 29:40 (twice in verse) + 14 t.; construct הִין Lev 19:36 ; — 1 a measure, used of quantity of water for drinking Ezek 4:11 ; usually in connection with offerings: a. of oil used with meal-offering Exod 29:40 ; Num 15:4 , 6 , 9 ; 28:5 (all P), Ezek 45:24 ; 46:5-6 , 11 , 14 ; — usually 1/4 hin to 1/10 ephah (of meal-offering); Num 15:6 1 /3; 15:9 1 /2; in Ezekiel a (whole) hin, except Ezek 46:14 3 -Janhin to 1/6. ephah. b. used in mixing the anointing oil Exod 30:24 . c. of wine as drink-offering Lev 23:13 (H); elsewhere P, Exod 29:40 ; Num 15:5 ; 28:14 (all 1/4 hin) 15:7 ; 28:14 (both 1/3 hin), 15:10 ; 28:14 (both 1/2 hin; all with 1/10 to 3/10 ephah in case of meal-offering). d. once of שֵׁכָר as drink-offering Num 28:7 (P; 1/4 hin; compare Di). 2 vessel with capacity of hin Lev 19:36 (H) הִיןצֶֿדֶק a just hin (|| צ ׳אֵיפַת ׳אַבְנֵיצֿ, צ, ׳מאֹזְנֵי ). — The hin = 1/6 bath according to Joseph. Ant. iii. 8 , 3; 9, 4, = 6.06 litres (Hultsch l.c .), see II. בַּת . On order of words in above passages, note that הִין ( ה ׳רְבִיעִת etc.) is usually appositive of liquid measured, & either precedes it Exod 29:40 ; Num 15:4 ; 28:14 , or, more often, follows it Exod 30:24 10 t.; Num 28:7 they are in different clauses; in Exod 29:40 we find הַהִין בְּשֶׁמֶןרֶ֗֗֗בַע , compare Num 15:6 , 9 ; 28:5 ; — 28:14 is peculiar: יָ֑יִן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הַהִין וּרְבִיעִת לָאַיִל הַהִין וּשְׁלִישִׁת לַמָּר יִהְיֶה הַהִין חֲצִי וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם ( יין only at end).
